// RED fixture for `no-cross-sync-cycle` — the REFS slice (REF-P2 / P-053). The lint MUST reject this.
//
// Every cross-subsystem Refs edge is async (an event/projection), never a synchronous call — the
// cross-subsystem call graph is acyclic (refined-arch reference-graph §3; EI-02 §3). Here the
// per-viewer resolution write path SYNCHRONOUSLY calls the owner subsystem to fetch the target's
// live title/state to enrich the edge — the "is it still there / what does it say?" sync call. That
// makes Refs a synchronous dependency of its own producers, opening a cycle. The display projection
// must come from Refs' OWN cached `*.updated` projection, fed over the bus, never a sync RPC.
// @write-path
pub async fn resolve_edge(client: &SyncServiceClient, edge: &Edge) -> ResolvedEdge {
    // BUG: a synchronous cross-subsystem call in the resolution write path — asks the owner for the
    // target's live state instead of reading Refs' own bus-fed projection. Opens a sync cycle.
    let target = client.call_sync(edge.target_root()).await;
    ResolvedEdge::new(edge, target)
}
